Rashi on Taanit 5b:10:1.english: Anyone who says "Rahab, Rahab" immediately experiences a seminal emission - He becomes one who has had a seminal emission.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:10:2.english: It does not matter to me - I am not concerned.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:10:3.english: Regarding one who knew her - This is also [the same as] one who recognized her.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:11:1.english: When he was taking leave - Rav Nachman from Rabbi Yitzchak.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:11:2.english: And its fruits were sweet - for the hungry [person].

Rashi on Taanit 5b:11:3.english: And its shade was pleasant - For this is needed by a tired person to rest beneath it.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:11:4.english: And a stream of water - for the thirsty [one].

Rashi on Taanit 5b:1:1.hebrew: ששקולה כשתים – דכותיים וקדריים, כדמפרש שהרעו משניהן, לא הבינו מהן. דכותיים וקדרים, אע"פ שיראתם פחותה, לא רצו להמיר; ועמי המירו באחר, ולא עוד אלא בלא יועיל:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:1:1.english: That it is equivalent to two - [That is,] of the Kittim and the Kedarites, as [the verse] explains that they acted more wickedly than both of them; they did not learn from them. For the Kittim and the Kedarites, even though their object of worship is inferior, did not want to exchange [it]; yet My people exchanged [their glory] for another, and not only that, but for that which does not profit.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:3:1.hebrew: והאמר מר - במועד קטן (דף כח.), זו מיתתו של שמואל הרמתי, ולא כרת היא. במסכת שמחות (פ"ג) מפרש: מת בכך שנים — זו היא מיתת כרת, בכך וכך — זו היא מיתת אסכרה:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:3:1.english: And did not the Master say - In Moed Katan (28a): "This is the death of Samuel of Ramah" — and it is not karet. In Tractate Semachot (ch. 3), it explains: "If one dies at such-and-such years, this is the death of karet; at such-and-such, this is the death of askara."

Rashi on Taanit 5b:3:2.hebrew: ימיו של שמואל נ"ב שנה - דכתיב עד יגמל הנער וגו', דשיבירי"ר בלע"ז, וכ"ד חדשים נקרא תינוק, וכתיב (שמואל א א׳:כ״ב) וישב שם עד עולם. עולמו של לוי חמשים שנה, שנאמר (במדבר ח׳:כ״ה) ומבן חמשים שנה ישוב מצבא העבודה. (בבכורות) ירושלמי, ובסדר עולם תמצא כשני דפין תוספת על זה:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:3:2.english: The days of Samuel were fifty-two years - As it is written: “until the child is weaned, etc.” — desevrer in Old French — and for twenty-four months he is called an infant; and it is written (I Samuel 1:22): “and he shall abide there forever.” The “forever” of a Levite is fifty years, as it is stated (Numbers 8:25): “and from the age of fifty years he shall return from the service of the work.” (Bekhorot) [In the] Yerushalmi, and in Seder Olam you will find about two pages of additional [material] on this.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:4:2.english: I regret - And the Holy One, blessed be He, wanted to kill him immediately.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:4:3.english: You have equated me with Moses and Aaron, as it is written: “Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among those who call upon His Name,” etc. - They are equal.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:4:4.hebrew: מעשה ידיהן - יהושע, אף הוא היה תלמידו של אהרן, כדאמרי' בעירובין (דף נד:): יצא משה ושנה להן אהרן פירקו:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:4:4.english: Their handiwork - [This refers to] Joshua; he too was a student of Aaron, as we say in Eruvin (54b): "Moses left, and Aaron taught them his lesson."

Rashi on Taanit 5b:5:1.english: When [he is] young - a young man.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:5:2.hebrew: מרנני כולי עלמא אבתריה - דאמרי, מדמית זוטר, שמא ח"ו עבירה היתה בו:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:5:2.english: Everyone will murmur about him - For they will say, "Since he died young, perhaps, Heaven forbid, there was a sin in him."

Rashi on Taanit 5b:6:1.english: What does Gibeah of Benjamin have to do with Ramah - [which is] in Mount Ephraim.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:6:2.hebrew: שישב ב' שנים ומחצה - כדמפרש בסדר עולם, שמלך מחצית שנת עשתי עשרה, ושנים עשרה, ושלשה עשר. ושמואל מת בתוך שנת שלש עשרה, לסוף שמונה חדשים:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:6:2.english: That he dwelled two and a half years - As it explains in Seder Olam, that he reigned for half of the eleventh year, and the twelfth [year], and the thirteenth [year]. And Samuel died within the thirteenth year, at the end of eight months.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:7:1.english: Is a man set aside, etc. - That Samuel was set aside before David.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:7:2.english: By their deeds is not stated - Which implies because of sin.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:7:3.english: Rather, by the words of My mouth - Because of a matter that I have decreed, such as this incident with Samuel.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:8:1.hebrew: ה"ג לימא לן מר מידי – ולא גרסינן חד לחבריה:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:8:1.english: Thus we read: "Let the Master say something to us" - And we do not read "one to his fellow."

Rashi on Taanit 5b:8:2.hebrew: שמא יקדים קנה – כשיוציא הקול, נפתח אותו כובע שעל פי הקנה, ונכנס בו המאכל ומסתכן, ולפיכך לא אומר לך כלום. מאכל ומשתה הולך דרך הושט:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:8:2.english: Lest the windpipe precede [the esophagus] - When one emits a voice, that cap [i.e., the epiglottis] over the opening of the windpipe opens, and food enters it and he is endangered; therefore, I will not say anything to you. Food and drink go by way of the esophagus.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:1.english: [He] did not die – Rather, he is alive forever.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:2.hebrew: בכדי – וכי בחנם ספדו ספדיא וחנטו חנטיא, דכתיב ביה (בראשית נ) ויחנטו (אותו) ויספדו (לו):
Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:2.english: For naught – Was it in vain that the eulogizers eulogized and the embalmers embalmed, as it is written concerning him (Genesis 50): "and they embalmed (him)" and "they eulogized (him)"?

Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:3.hebrew: מקרא אני דורש – והאי דחנטו חנטיא, סבורים היו שמת:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:3.english: I am interpreting a verse - And [as for] that which the embalmers embalmed [him], they thought that he had died.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:4.hebrew: מה זרעו בחיים – כשהוא מקבץ את ישראל מארץ שבים, החיים הוא מקבץ שהן בשבי, שהמתים אינן בשבי:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:4.english: Just as his seed is alive - When He gathers Israel from the land of their captivity, it is the living whom He gathers, who are in captivity, for the dead are not in captivity.

Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:5.hebrew: אף הוא בחיים - שיביאנו בגולה כדי לגאול את בניו לעיניו, כמו שמצינו במצרים: ״וירא ישראל וגו'״, ודרשינן: ישראל סבא. ודחנטו חנטיא — נדמה להם שמת, אבל חי היה:
Rashi on Taanit 5b:9:5.english: So too, he is alive - [Meaning] that He will bring him into the exile in order to redeem his children before his eyes, just as we find in Egypt: "And Israel saw, etc.," and we expound [this as referring to] Israel the Elder. And [as for] "that the embalmers embalmed [him]" — it appeared to them that he had died, but he was alive.

Tosafot on Taanit 5b:10:1.hebrew: ביודעה ומכירה קאמינא - פי': ביודעה — שבא עליה, ומכירה — שראה אותה:
Tosafot on Taanit 5b:10:1.english: "[When] I said [this, I meant] one who knew her and recognized her" - Explanation: "one who knew her" [means] that he had relations with her, and "one who recognized her" [means] that he had seen her.

Tosafot on Taanit 5b:3:1.hebrew: ומי סיב שמואל והא בר נ"ב שנין הוה וכו' - ועתה (אפי') חיי שמואל נ"ב שנה, שהרי בשנה ראשונה שהיה עלי ממונה לכ"ג נולד שמואל, כדכתיב (שמואל א א׳:ט׳): "ועלי יושב", כלומר: אותו יום נתיישב ונתמנה. ועלי היה נביא ושופט ארבעים שנה, כדמפרש בקרא, ושמואל היה נביא ושופט י' שנים קודם מלכות שאול, כדאיתא בסדר עולם. נמצא שהיה שמואל בן מ"ט שנה כשפסק מלהיות שופט, וחצי שנה שבשנה ראשונה שהיה עלי נביא נולד, ותרתין שנין ופלגא דשאול המלך — הרי נ"ב שנין; ולהכי קא פריך: "ומי סיב". ומורי ש"י חשיב הני ארבעים שנה דעלי קודם שנשבה הארון, ובאותו יום שנשבה מת, כדכתיב: "ויהי כהזכירו ארון האלהים ויפול אחורנית ותשבר מפרקתו וגו'". והארון היה בבית אבינדב בגבעה עשרים שנה, כדכתיב (שמואל א ז׳:ב׳): "וירבו הימים ויהיו עשרים שנה וינהו כל בית ישראל אחרי ה'", ומיד כשמלך דוד בירושלים — דהיינו לאחר כשמלך בחברון שבע שנים ומחצה — הביאו לשם. צא וחשוב ארבעים שחיה עלי עם עשרים שנה שהיה הארון בבית אבינדב — היינו ששים; נמצא שהיה ששים שנה משנולד שמואל עד שבא הארון בירושלים. אע"ג דנולד בשנה הראשונה, א"כ נכי לפחות חצי שנה דהריון — אותן שבעה חדשים היה הארון בשדה פלשתים דלא קא חשיב, ומלי' להנהו דשעת הריון. נמצא שהיה שמונה שנים ממיתת שמואל עד שבא הארון לירושלים, שהרי היה ששה חדשים ממיתת שמואל קודם שמשחו דוד למלך בחברון, ומלך שם שבע שנים ומחצה, ומיד מלך בירושלים והביא הארון. ועתה הסר שמונה שנים מן ששים שנים שהיה משנולד שמואל עד הבאת הארון, וישאר נ"ב שנים:
Tosafot on Taanit 5b:3:1.english: And did Samuel grow so old? But he was fifty-two years old, etc. - And now, (even) the lifespan of Samuel was fifty-two years, for in the first year that Eli was appointed High Priest, Samuel was born, as it is written (I Samuel 1:9): "And Eli was sitting," meaning that on that day he was seated and appointed. And Eli was a prophet and judge for forty years, as is stated explicitly in Scripture, and Samuel was a prophet and judge for ten years prior to the reign of Saul, as is taught in Seder Olam. Thus it emerges that Samuel was forty-nine years old when he ceased to be judge, plus the half year in the first year that Eli was a prophet when he was born, plus the two and a half years of King Saul — making fifty-two years; and therefore [the Gemara] asks: "And did [Samuel] grow so old?" And my teacher, may he live, calculates these forty years of Eli [as ending] before the Ark was captured, and on that very day that it was captured he died, as it is written: "And it came to pass, when he made mention of the Ark of God, that he fell backward... and his neck broke, etc." And the Ark was in the house of Avinadav in Givah for twenty years, as it is written (I Samuel 7:2): "And the days multiplied, and it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel yearned after the Lord," and immediately when David became king in Jerusalem — that is, after he had reigned in Hebron for seven and a half years — he brought it there. Go and calculate the forty [years] that Eli lived together with the twenty years that the Ark was in the house of Avinadav — that is sixty; thus it emerges that there were sixty years from when Samuel was born until the Ark came to Jerusalem. Even though he was born in the first year, and if so you should deduct at least the half year of pregnancy — those seven months that the Ark was in the field of the Philistines, which [this calculation] did not count, make up for that time of pregnancy. Thus it emerges that there were eight years from the death of Samuel until the Ark came to Jerusalem, for there were six months from the death of Samuel before they anointed David as king in Hebron, and he reigned there for seven and a half years, and immediately [thereafter] he reigned in Jerusalem and brought the Ark. And now, subtract eight years from the sixty years that elapsed from when Samuel was born until the bringing of the Ark, and fifty-two years remain.

Tosafot on Taanit 5b:9:1.hebrew: יעקב אבינו לא מת - וכן משמע, דכתיב "ויגוע" ולא כתיב "וימת", כדמפרש בסוטה (דף יג.) גבי מעשה דחושים:
Tosafot on Taanit 5b:9:1.english: Our patriarch Jacob did not die - And so it is implied, as it is written: "and he expired," and it is not written "and he died" [Genesis 49:33], as [the Gemara] explains in Sotah (13a) regarding the incident of Chushim.
